name: Mortal Desires
source:
In Crimson Beech, things turn sinister for local girl Libby Rogers as the supernatural truths of the original Immortal Desires saga unfold.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Mortal_Desires]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
隨著《不朽慾望》本傳裡的種種超自然真相一一揭開，緋紅山毛櫸鎮的本地姑娘莉比．羅傑斯也察覺到，身邊的事透出了一股不祥的氣息。

［摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Mortal_Desires]Choices維基[/url]］
